patch_description: Key parameters in the current approach: fixed 20 restarts of greedy sampling (num_samples=6, sample_rate=0.95) plus one full 2-opt style swap/reinsertion local search. The new approach replaces fixed iteration counts with a wall-clock time budget (~2.5s per workload): run randomized greedy restarts continuously, and after each greedy solution apply first-improvement pairwise-swap local search (cheaper than full best-improvement VNS). Track best globally. Using more greedy restarts with smaller sample counts and a cheaper local search per restart yields more diverse candidates within the budget, which empirically lowers makespan. Also defensively import time both at module level and inside the function to avoid NameError failures.
